metadata.title: A second eight-faced polyhedron in which every two faces share an edge
metadata.abstract: We report a novel polyhedral surface of genus~3 embedded in $\mathbb{R}^3$ with eight planar, simple, non-convex nonagonal faces, 24 vertices and 36 edges, in which every two faces share at least one edge: 20 pairs of faces share one edge and 8 pairs share two collinear edges. Its face planes are $3x-4y-2z=5$, $-2x+5y-5z=3$ and their images under the half-turns about the three coordinate axes, and all vertices are rational. The polyhedron has the same face vector, face sizes and number of edge multiplicities as the polyhedron described by Mizhaev, but it is not combinatorially equivalent to it. Our realisation has the symmetry group $D_2$ of order~4, whereas Mizhaev's polyhedron has a rotoreflection symmetry. The example was found by a computational geometric search, and all its properties were verified in exact rational arithmetic.

analysis.workSummary: 构造 R3 中属三的八面多面曲面，面为简单非凸九边形，每对面共享边，所有顶点有理；与已知同面向量例组合不等价并具有 D2 对称。
analysis.breakthrough: 丰富面之间最大邻接的稀少可实现例。
analysis.limitations: 为单个特定构造，不能推出一般存在或分类定理。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者在结语及致谢明确说明使用高度自主 AI 框架开发、优化和实现 Python 搜索算法，并承认 Claude 在论文多数阶段的显著参与；输出经作者复核。依据足以标注计算、探索和验证，不推断核心创意归属。
